svg.title: Rock grout curtain — Þéttitjald með bergsprautun
svg.desc: A row of three drilled injection holes feeds branching rock fissures beneath a common ground surface.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-rock-grout-curtain","label_en":"Rock grout curtain","label_is":"Þéttitjald með bergsprautun","section":"04","category_en":"Excavation, foundations and ground engineering","category_is":"Uppgröftur, undirstöður og jarðtækni","batch":2,"tags":["ground-improvement","grouting"],"description":"A row of three drilled injection holes feeds branching rock fissures beneath a common ground surface.","design_note":"Separate boreholes connected to irregular fractures depict a subsurface grout curtain rather than vertical pile supports.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
